Class SelectionController

java.lang.Object
controllers.Controller<SelectionView>
controllers.SelectionController
public class SelectionController extends Controller<SelectionView>
Controller for the Bugémon selection screen. Handles both new team creation and editing of existing teams.

    • confirmSelection

      public void confirmSelection(TeamBugemonDTO playerTeamDTO, String teamName)
      Confirms the current selection. Updates the existing team if editing, or adds a new named team to the shared list.
      Parameters:
      playerTeamDTO - the team built by the player, cast internally to TeamBugemon
      teamName - the name for the new team (ignored in edit mode)
